profile.description: Agentic web app developer made for creating canvas web apps, powered by a massive context window, it refines and polishes your app. App-Generator does multi-step-reasoning to preview, debug and refine complete HTML applications in real time. This bot is updated frequently to ensure you’re always using the most efficient, modern, and cost-effective AI available.
profile.poweredBy: Powered by GPT-6-Luna, a model that is hosted by Poe and third party model providers.

Message cost is variable, so longer messages are more expensive than shorter messages. 

| Type | Rate (USD) | Rate (Points) |
|------|------|------|
| Input | $0.10/1M tokens | 4 points/1k tokens |
| Output (text) | $0.51/1M tokens | 17 points/1k tokens |
| Output | $0.010/search | 334 points/search |
| Bot message | $0.023/message | 750 points/message |
| Cache discount | 90% discount on [cached chat](https://help.poe.com/hc/en-us/articles/19944206309524-Poe-FAQs#h_01JMDGNARXH8B0MN452N6N7XHP) |  |


Web searches will add input tokens.

Input rate is 2x and output rate is 1.5x when context is >272k tokens.

When new content is written to the cache, it costs 25% more points than the original input and stays stored for 5 minutes before automatically expiring.
